title: Accessible tab panels
text: Tabs and panels are linked for screen readers, with roving focus on the tab list.

title: Automatic or manual
text: Activate tabs as focus moves, or only when users press Enter or Space.

title: Two orientations
text: Horizontal or vertical layouts with the matching arrow key mapping and RTL support.

title: Disabled tabs
text: Disabled tabs stay visible and are skipped by keyboard navigation.
